propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store_mod, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings to binding_lifecycle_mod which resolves its own _now_iso, causing the patch to no longer reach those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the blast radius has narrowed and would not catch a regression that made clear_absent stamp updated_at unconditionally.

The integration test must patch _now_iso on both binding_store_mod and binding_lifecycle_mod to restore original oracle reach and fail if any binding operation stamps a timestamp on an unchanged pass.

clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window idempotency pass due to gating conditions at its call sites in binding_walk.py and outbound_differ.py, making integration-tier mutation verification infeasible without test harness extension.
